scripts.script:
--[[
    WAVE UNIVERSAL v1.7
    Roblox Studio LocalScript
    Place in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts
]]

-- SERVICES
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RS = game:GetService("RunService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- CONFIG
local LOGO_ID = "rbxassetid://115299800628540"

local themeOrder = { "Cyan", "Crimson", "Purple", "Monochrome" }
local themes = {
    Cyan = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255),
    Crimson = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 60),
    Purple = Color3.fromRGB(170, 80, 255),
    Monochrome = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220),
}

local accent = themes.Cyan
local backgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 19)
local panelColor = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 31)
local textColor = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245)

local musicIds = {
    "1846088038",
    "1836009208",
    "9045766377",
    "9045766074",
}

-- STATE
local alive = true
local noclipEnabled = false
local infiniteJumpEnabled = false
local espEnabled = false
local musicEnabled = false

local selectedWalkSpeed = 16
local selectedJumpPower = 50
local musicIndex = 0

local connections = {}
local highlights = {}
local originalCollision = {}
local originalWalkSpeed
local originalJumpPower

local logEntries = {}
local logLabel

local sectionLabels = {}
local windowStroke
local title
local logo
local reopen
local reopenLogo
local musicToggleButton

local function track(connection)
    table.insert(connections, connection)
    return connection
end

local function log(message)
    local entry = os.date("%H:%M:%S") .. "  " .. tostring(message)
    table.insert(logEntries, entry)

    if #logEntries > 100 then
        table.remove(logEntries, 1)
    end

    if logLabel and logLabel.Parent then
        logLabel.Text = table.concat(logEntries, "\n")
    end

    print("[Wave Universal] " .. tostring(message))
end

-- PLAYER HELPERS
local function getCharacter()
    return player.Character
end

local function getHumanoid()
    local character = getCharacter()
    return character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function saveMovementDefaults()
    local humanoid = getHumanoid()
    if not humanoid then return end

    originalWalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
    originalJumpPower = humanoid.JumpPower
end

saveMovementDefaults()

local function restoreMovement()
    local humanoid = getHumanoid()
    if not humanoid then return end

    if originalWalkSpeed then
        humanoid.WalkSpeed = originalWalkSpeed
    end

    if originalJumpPower then
        humanoid.JumpPower = originalJumpPower
    end
end

local function applyWalkSpeed(value)
    selectedWalkSpeed = value

    local humanoid = getHumanoid()
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.WalkSpeed = value
    end

    log("WalkSpeed set to " .. value)
end

local function applyJumpPower(value)
    selectedJumpPower = value

    local humanoid = getHumanoid()
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
        humanoid.JumpPower = value
    end

    log("JumpPower set to " .. value)
end

-- GUI ROOT
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "WaveUniversal"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
gui.Parent = playerGui

local function makeCorner(object, radius)
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 8)
    corner.Parent = object
    return corner
end

local function makeStroke(object, color, thickness)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = color or accent
    stroke.Thickness = thickness or 1
    stroke.Transparency = 0.2
    stroke.Parent = object
    return stroke
end

local function makeLabel(parent, text, size, position, fontSize)
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = text
    label.Size = size
    label.Position = position
    label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    label.TextSize = fontSize or 13
    label.TextColor3 = textColor
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.TextWrapped = true
    label.Parent = parent
    return label
end

local function makeButton(parent, text, size, position, callback)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.AutoButtonColor = true
    button.BackgroundColor3 = panelColor
    button.BorderSizePixel = 0
    button.Text = text
    button.Size = size
    button.Position = position
    button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    button.TextSize = 12
    button.TextColor3 = textColor
    button.Parent = parent

    makeCorner(button, 7)
    makeStroke(button, Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65), 1)

    if callback then
        button.Activated:Connect(callback)
    end

    return button
end

-- MAIN WINDOW
local window = Instance.new("Frame")
window.Name = "MainWindow"
window.Size = UDim2.new(0, 540, 0, 360)
window.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -270, 0.5, -180)
window.BackgroundColor3 = backgroundColor
window.BorderSizePixel = 0
window.Parent = gui

makeCorner(window, 10)
windowStroke = makeStroke(window, accent, 1.5)

local header = Instance.new("Frame")
header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42)
header.BackgroundColor3 = panelColor
header.BorderSizePixel = 0
header.Parent = window

makeCorner(header, 10)

logo = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
logo.Name = "WaveLogo"
logo.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28)
logo.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 7)
logo.BackgroundTransparency = 1
logo.Image = LOGO_ID
logo.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
logo.Parent = header

title = makeLabel(
    header,
    "WAVE UNIVERSAL",
    UDim2.new(1, -155, 1, 0),
    UDim2.new(0, 43, 0, 0),
    14
)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

-- SIDEBAR
local sidebar = Instance.new("Frame")
sidebar.Name = "Sidebar"
sidebar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 50)
sidebar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 105, 1, -58)
sidebar.BackgroundColor3 = panelColor
sidebar.BorderSizePixel = 0
sidebar.Parent = window

makeCorner(sidebar, 8)

local sidebarLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
sidebarLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
sidebarLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
sidebarLayout.Parent = sidebar

local sidebarPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
sidebarPadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8)
sidebarPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6)
sidebarPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
sidebarPadding.Parent = sidebar

-- CONTENT AREA
local content = Instance.new("Frame")
content.Name = "Content"
content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 121, 0, 50)
content.Size = UDim2.new(1, -129, 1, -58)
content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
content.Parent = window

local pages = {}
local tabButtons = {}

local function createPage(name)
    local page = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    page.Name = name .. "Page"
    page.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    page.BorderSizePixel = 0
    page.ScrollBarThickness = 4
    page.ScrollBarImageColor3 = accent
    page.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    page.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    page.Visible = false
    page.Parent = content

    local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
    layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    layout.Parent = page

    local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 3)
    padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 3)
    padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 7)
    padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8)
    padding.Parent = page

    pages[name] = page
    return page
end

local function showTab(name)
    for pageName, page in pairs(pages) do
        page.Visible = pageName == name
    end

    for tabName, tab in pairs(tabButtons) do
        tab.BackgroundColor3 = tabName == name and accent or panelColor
        tab.TextColor3 = tabName == name and Color3.new(0, 0, 0) or textColor
    end
end

local function createTab(name, order)
    local tab = makeButton(
        sidebar,
        name,
        UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34),
        UDim2.new(),
        function()
            showTab(name)
        end
    )

    tab.LayoutOrder = order
    tabButtons[name] = tab
    createPage(name)

    return pages[name]
end

-- CONTROL HELPERS
local function addSection(parent, text)
    local label = makeLabel(
        parent,
        text,
        UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25),
        UDim2.new(),
        14
    )

    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    label.TextColor3 = accent
    table.insert(sectionLabels, label)
    return label
end

local function addAction(parent, text, callback)
    return makeButton(
        parent,
        text,
        UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34),
        UDim2.new(),
        callback
    )
end

local function addSlider(parent, name, minimum, maximum, initial, callback)
    local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
    holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58)
    holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    holder.Parent = parent

    local valueLabel = makeLabel(
        holder,
        name .. ": " .. initial,
        UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22),
        UDim2.new(),
        12
    )

    local bar = Instance.new("TextButton")
    bar.Name = "SliderBar"
    bar.Text = ""
    bar.AutoButtonColor = false
    bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 10)
    bar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 32)
    bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 58)
    bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    bar.Parent = holder

    makeCorner(bar, 5)

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.new((initial - minimum) / (maximum - minimum), 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = accent
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Parent = bar

    makeCorner(fill, 5)

    local dragging = false

    local function update(input)
        local width = math.max(bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
        local fraction = math.clamp(
            (input.Position.X - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / width,
            0,
            1
        )

        local currentValue = math.floor(
            minimum + fraction * (maximum - minimum) + 0.5
        )

        fill.Size = UDim2.new(
            (currentValue - minimum) / (maximum - minimum),
            0,
            1,
            0
        )

        valueLabel.Text = name .. ": " .. currentValue
        callback(currentValue)
    end

    bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            update(input)
        end
    end)

    track(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not dragging then return end

        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            update(input)
        end
    end))

    track(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end))

    return holder
end

local function addToggle(parent, name, callback)
    local enabled = false
    local button

    button = addAction(parent, name .. ": OFF", function()
        enabled = not enabled
        button.Text = name .. ": " .. (enabled and "ON" or "OFF")
        button.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and accent or panelColor
        button.TextColor3 = enabled and Color3.new(0, 0, 0) or textColor

        callback(enabled)
        log(name .. (enabled and " enabled" or " disabled"))
    end)

    return button
end

-- CREATE TABS
createTab("Home", 1)
createTab("Player", 2)
createTab("ESP", 3)
createTab("Info Log", 4)
createTab("Music", 5)
createTab("Settings", 6)

-- HOME
local homePage = pages["Home"]

addSection(homePage, "Welcome to Wave Universal")

makeLabel(
    homePage,
    "A compact utility panel for your own Roblox Studio experience.",
    UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42),
    UDim2.new(),
    12
)

addAction(homePage, "Refresh Character", function()
    if getCharacter() then
        log("Character is loaded")
    else
        log("Character is not loaded")
    end
end)

addAction(homePage, "Show Current Settings", function()
    log("WalkSpeed: " .. selectedWalkSpeed)
    log("JumpPower: " .. selectedJumpPower)
    log("Noclip: " .. tostring(noclipEnabled))
    log("Infinite Jump: " .. tostring(infiniteJumpEnabled))
    log("ESP: " .. tostring(espEnabled))
    log("Music: " .. tostring(musicEnabled))
end)

-- PLAYER
local playerPage = pages["Player"]

addSection(playerPage, "Movement")

addSlider(playerPage, "WalkSpeed", 0, 100, selectedWalkSpeed, applyWalkSpeed)
addSlider(playerPage, "JumpPower", 0, 150, selectedJumpPower, applyJumpPower)

local function setNoclip(enabled)
    noclipEnabled = enabled

    if not enabled then
        for part, oldValue in pairs(originalCollision) do
            if part and part.Parent then
                part.CanCollide = oldValue
            end
        end

        table.clear(originalCollision)
    end
end

addToggle(playerPage, "Noclip", setNoclip)

addToggle(playerPage, "Infinite Jump", function(enabled)
    infiniteJumpEnabled = enabled
end)

track(UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if not alive or not infiniteJumpEnabled then return end

    local humanoid = getHumanoid()
    if humanoid then
        humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
    end
end))

track(RS.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if not alive or not noclipEnabled then return end

    local character = getCharacter()
    if not character then return end

    for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            if originalCollision[part] == nil then
                originalCollision[part] = part.CanCollide
            end

            part.CanCollide = false
        end
    end
end))

track(player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    originalCollision = {}

    task.wait(0.5)
    if not alive then return end

    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then
        originalWalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
        originalJumpPower = humanoid.JumpPower

        humanoid.WalkSpeed = selectedWalkSpeed
        humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
        humanoid.JumpPower = selectedJumpPower
    end
end))

-- ESP
local espPage = pages["ESP"]

addSection(espPage, "Player Highlight")

makeLabel(
    espPage,
    "Highlights other players in this experience. Uses occluded depth mode.",
    UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40),
    UDim2.new(),
    12
)

local function createHighlight(character)
    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Name = "WavePlayerHighlight"
    highlight.Adornee = character
    highlight.FillColor = accent
    highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.65
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
    highlight.Parent = character
    return highlight
end

local function clearHighlights()
    for playerObject, highlight in pairs(highlights) do
        if highlight then
            highlight:Destroy()
        end
        highlights[playerObject] = nil
    end
end

local function refreshESP()
    if not espEnabled then
        clearHighlights()
        return
    end

    for _, otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if otherPlayer ~= player then
            local character = otherPlayer.Character
            local existing = highlights[otherPlayer]

            -- Drop highlights that belong to a dead or replaced character
            if existing and (not character or existing.Adornee ~= character) then
                existing:Destroy()
                highlights[otherPlayer] = nil
            end

            if character and not highlights[otherPlayer] then
                highlights[otherPlayer] = createHighlight(character)
            end
        end
    end
end

addToggle(espPage, "Player ESP", function(enabled)
    espEnabled = enabled

    if enabled then
        refreshESP()
    else
        clearHighlights()
    end
end)

track(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function()
    task.delay(1, refreshESP)
end))

track(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(leavingPlayer)
    local highlight = highlights[leavingPlayer]
    if highlight then
        highlight:Destroy()
        highlights[leavingPlayer] = nil
    end
end))

local espTimer = 0

track(RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
    if not alive or not espEnabled then return end

    espTimer += deltaTime
    if espTimer >= 1 then
        espTimer = 0
        refreshESP()
    end
end))

-- INFO LOG
local infoPage = pages["Info Log"]

addSection(infoPage, "Activity")

logLabel = makeLabel(
    infoPage,
    "Wave Universal initialized.",
    UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 0),
    UDim2.new(),
    11
)

logLabel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
logLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
logLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code

addAction(infoPage, "Clear Log", function()
    table.clear(logEntries)
    logLabel.Text = ""
end)

-- MUSIC
local musicPage = pages["Music"]

addSection(musicPage, "Music Player")

makeLabel(
    musicPage,
    "Cycles through the configured audio IDs. Audio availability depends on Roblox permissions.",
    UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48),
    UDim2.new(),
    12
)

local music = Instance.new("Sound")
music.Name = "WaveMusic"
music.Volume = 0.35
music.Looped = false
music.Parent = SoundService

local playNextTrack

playNextTrack = function()
    if not alive or not musicEnabled then return end

    musicIndex = (musicIndex % #musicIds) + 1
    music.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. musicIds[musicIndex]
    music:Play()

    log("Playing playlist track " .. musicIndex)

    -- If a track fails to load, Ended never fires, so skip ahead after a delay
    local expectedIndex = musicIndex
    task.delay(15, function()
        if musicEnabled and musicIndex == expectedIndex and not music.IsPlaying then
            playNextTrack()
        end
    end)
end

track(music.Ended:Connect(function()
    if musicEnabled then
        playNextTrack()
    end
end))

musicToggleButton = addAction(musicPage, "Play Playlist", function()
    if musicEnabled then
        musicEnabled = false
        music:Stop()
        musicToggleButton.Text = "Play Playlist"
        log("Music stopped")
    else
        musicEnabled = true
        musicToggleButton.Text = "Stop Music"
        playNextTrack()
    end
end)

addAction(musicPage, "Next Track", function()
    musicEnabled = true
    musicToggleButton.Text = "Stop Music"
    playNextTrack()
end)

-- SETTINGS
local settingsPage = pages["Settings"]

addSection(settingsPage, "Appearance")

local function applyTheme(themeName)
    accent = themes[themeName] or themes.Cyan

    windowStroke.Color = accent
    title.TextColor3 = accent
    logo.Image = LOGO_ID

    for _, label in ipairs(sectionLabels) do
        label.TextColor3 = accent
    end

    for _, page in pairs(pages) do
        page.ScrollBarImageColor3 = accent
    end

    for name, tab in pairs(tabButtons) do
        if pages[name].Visible then
            tab.BackgroundColor3 = accent
            tab.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        else
            tab.BackgroundColor3 = panelColor
            tab.TextColor3 = textColor
        end
    end

    for _, highlight in pairs(highlights) do
        if highlight then
            highlight.FillColor = accent
        end
    end

    if reopen then
        reopen.BackgroundColor3 = accent
    end
    if reopenLogo then
        reopenLogo.Image = LOGO_ID
    end

    log("Theme changed to " .. themeName)
end

for _, themeName in ipairs(themeOrder) do
    addAction(settingsPage, "Theme: " .. themeName, function()
        applyTheme(themeName)
    end)
end

-- WINDOW DRAGGING
local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

track(header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = window.Position
    end
end))

track(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not dragging then return end

    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        local delta = input.Position - dragStart

        window.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end))

track(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = false
    end
end))

-- FLOATING REOPEN BUTTON
reopen = makeButton(
    gui,
    "",
    UDim2.fromOffset(44, 44),
    UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.5, -22),
    function()
        if alive then
            window.Visible = true
            reopen.Visible = false
        end
    end
)

reopen.Name = "WaveReopen"
reopen.BackgroundColor3 = accent
reopen.Visible = false
reopen.ZIndex = 20

reopenLogo = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
reopenLogo.Name = "WaveLogo"
reopenLogo.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 1, -6)
reopenLogo.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 3)
reopenLogo.BackgroundTransparency = 1
reopenLogo.Image = LOGO_ID
reopenLogo.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
reopenLogo.ZIndex = 21
reopenLogo.Parent = reopen

-- HEADER BUTTONS
local minimize = makeButton(
    header,

scripts.script:
--[[
	rocheese.luau - RoChess! engine panel + autopilot
	Luau, Real executor, client side.

	Uses the game's own modules instead of re-implementing chess:
		ReplicatedStorage.Chess.Engine       board, legal moves, UCI/SAN, FEN
		ReplicatedStorage.Chess.Bot          local search: analyse(fen,moves,sec,depth) / think(fen,moves,persona)
		ReplicatedStorage.Chess.VortexBot    server engine bridge: analyse / think
		ReplicatedStorage.ChessClient.App    live client state: session, board, onBoardMove, playMove

	Squares use Engine.algToIndex64 (bottom-up, a1 = 1, h8 = 64).
	Engine scores are always from WHITE's side of the board.

	Panel: top-right, drag it by the title.
	Arrows on the board:
		green  = best move      blue = second best      yellow = third best

	Presets:
		LEGIT  local engine, plays like a 1500 human (noise + blunders), 5-10s per move
		RAJ    server engine (Vortex), always the best move, plays fast

	Controls: STYLE, DELAY min/max, PLAY BEST/ELO, ENGINE LOCAL/VORTEX, AUTOPLAY,
	          PLAY NOW, COPY FEN, BOT GAME.
	Hotkeys: End auto | Home arrow | PageUp hide | PageDown source | Insert copy fen.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Chess = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Chess")
local Client = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ChessClient")

local function req(mod)
	return require(mod)
end

local Engine = req(Chess:WaitForChild("Engine"))
local Bot = req(Chess:WaitForChild("Bot"))
local VortexBot = req(Chess:WaitForChild("VortexBot"))
local App = req(Client:WaitForChild("App"))

local GENV = getgenv()
GENV.__RoCheeseGen = (GENV.__RoCheeseGen or 0) + 1
local GEN = GENV.__RoCheeseGen

local CFG = {
	W = 344,
	H = 424,
	MARGIN = 14,
	TOP = 84,
	DEPTH = 16,
	SECONDS = 0.8,
	CHILD_DEPTH = 8,
	CHILD_SECONDS = 0.06,
	VK_SHIFT = 160,
	PROMO = { q = 5, r = 4, b = 3, n = 2 },
	ARROW_1 = Color3.fromRGB(129, 182, 76),
	ARROW_2 = Color3.fromRGB(96, 156, 240),
	ARROW_3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 200, 70),
	DELAY_MIN = 0,
	DELAY_MAX = 20,
	DELAY_STEP = 0.5,
}

local PRESETS = {
	legit = {
		label = "LEGIT",
		source = "local",
		mode = "elo",
		elo = 1500,
		noise = 0.32,
		blunder = 0.06,
		delayMin = 5,
		delayMax = 10,
	},
	raj = {
		label = "RAJ",
		source = "vortex",
		mode = "best",
		elo = 1800,
		noise = 0,
		blunder = 0,
		delayMin = 0.5,
		delayMax = 1.5,
	},
}

local RUNTIME = GENV.__RoCheese or {}
RUNTIME.SHOW_ARROW = RUNTIME.SHOW_ARROW ~= false
RUNTIME.AUTO = RUNTIME.AUTO == true
RUNTIME.HUMANIZE = RUNTIME.HUMANIZE ~= false
RUNTIME.SOURCE = RUNTIME.SOURCE == "vortex" and "vortex" or "local"
RUNTIME.MODE = RUNTIME.MODE == "best" and "best" or "elo"
RUNTIME.ELO = tonumber(RUNTIME.ELO) or 1500
RUNTIME.NOISE = tonumber(RUNTIME.NOISE) or 0.32
RUNTIME.BLUNDER = tonumber(RUNTIME.BLUNDER) or 0.06
RUNTIME.DELAY_MIN = math.clamp(tonumber(RUNTIME.DELAY_MIN) or 5, CFG.DELAY_MIN, CFG.DELAY_MAX)
RUNTIME.DELAY_MAX = math.clamp(tonumber(RUNTIME.DELAY_MAX) or 10, CFG.DELAY_MIN, CFG.DELAY_MAX)
RUNTIME.STYLE = RUNTIME.STYLE == "raj" and "raj" or (RUNTIME.STYLE == "legit" and "legit" or "custom")
GENV.__RoCheese = RUNTIME

local ARROW_KEYS = { "rc1", "rc2", "rc3" }

local S = {
	ply = -1,
	sessionId = nil,
	best = nil,
	san = nil,
	score = 0,
	depth = 0,
	second = nil,
	third = nil,
	secondSan = nil,
	thirdSan = nil,
	busy = false,
	autoAt = 0,
	thinkAt = 0,
	status = "loading",
}
GENV.__RoCheeseState = S

local LIVE = _G.STATE

local function alive()
	if GENV.__RoCheeseGen ~= GEN then
		return false
	end
	if typeof(LIVE) == "table" and type(LIVE.alive) == "function" then
		return LIVE.alive()
	end
	return true
end

local function cleanup(fn)
	if typeof(LIVE) == "table" and type(LIVE.onCleanup) == "function" then
		LIVE.onCleanup(fn)
	end
end

-- board ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function clearArrows()
	local board = App.board
	if not board or type(board.setArrow) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	for _, key in ARROW_KEYS do
		pcall(function()
			board:setArrow(key, nil)
			board:setTint(key, nil)
		end)
	end
	-- older build of this script used a single arrow key
	pcall(function()
		board:setArrow("rocheese", nil)
		board:setTint("rocheese", nil)
	end)
end

local function drawArrow(key, uci, color, tint)
	local board = App.board
	if not board then
		return
	end
	local from = Engine.algToIndex64(uci:sub(1, 2))
	local to = Engine.algToIndex64(uci:sub(3, 4))
	if not from or not to then
		return
	end
	pcall(function()
		board:setArrow(key, from, to, color, 0.12)
		if tint then
			board:setTint(key, to, color, 0.26)
		end
	end)
end

-- engine ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function buildEngine(startFen, moves)
	local engine = Engine.new(startFen)
	for _, uci in ipairs(moves) do
		local mv = engine:moveFromUci(uci)
		if not mv then
			return nil
		end
		engine:play(mv)
	end
	return engine
end

local function sanOf(engine, uci)
	if not engine or not uci then
		return nil
	end
	local want = string.lower(uci)
	for _, mv in engine:legalMoves() do
		local u = engine:moveToUci(mv)
		if u and string.lower(u) == want then
			return engine:moveToSan(mv)
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function analyseBest(startFen, moves)
	if RUNTIME.SOURCE == "vortex" then
		local ok, res = pcall(VortexBot.analyse, startFen, moves, CFG.SECONDS, CFG.DEPTH)
		if ok and type(res) == "table" and res.best then
			return res
		end
	end
	local ok, res = pcall(Bot.analyse, startFen, moves, CFG.SECONDS, CFG.DEPTH)
	if ok and type(res) == "table" then
		return res
	end
	return nil
end

-- ranks every continuation of the position, so the 2nd and 3rd arrows have a real order
local function rankContinuations(startFen, moves, skipUci)
	local engine = buildEngine(startFen, moves)
	if not engine then
		return nil
	end
	local scored = {}
	for _, mv in engine:legalMoves() do
		local uci = engine:moveToUci(mv)
		if not skipUci or string.lower(uci) ~= string.lower(skipUci) then
			local child = Engine.new(startFen)
			local ok = pcall(function()
				child:playUci(uci)
			end)
			if ok then
				local cres = Bot.analyse(child:getFen(), {}, CFG.CHILD_SECONDS, CFG.CHILD_DEPTH)
				table.insert(scored, {
					uci = uci,
					san = engine:moveToSan(mv),
					score = tonumber(cres and cres.score) or 0,
				})
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(scored, function(a, b)
		return a.score > b.score
	end)
	return scored
end

local function pickMove(session)
	if RUNTIME.MODE == "elo" then
		local ok, uci = pcall(Bot.think, session.startFen, table.clone(session.ucis), {
			rating = RUNTIME.ELO,
			noise = RUNTIME.NOISE,
			blunder = RUNTIME.BLUNDER,
			time = 0.6,
			depth = 14,
		})
		if ok and type(uci) == "string" then
			return uci
		end
	end
	return S.best
end

-- playing ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function tapInput()
	if not RUNTIME.HUMANIZE then
		return
	end
	if type(keyclick) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	if type(isrbxactive) == "function" and not isrbxactive() then
		return
	end
	pcall(keyclick, CFG.VK_SHIFT)
end

local function playUci(uci)
	local session = App.session
	if not session or session.over then
		return false, "no game"
	end
	if not session:isMyTurn() then
		return false, "not your turn"
	end
	local from = Engine.algToIndex64(uci:sub(1, 2))
	local to = Engine.algToIndex64(uci:sub(3, 4))
	if not from or not to then
		return false, "bad uci"
	end
	local promo = CFG.PROMO[uci:sub(5, 5)] or 0
	local before = #session.ucis
	tapInput()
	local ok = false
	pcall(function()
		-- same call a square click makes: local apply + packed move to the server
		ok = App.onBoardMove(from, to, promo, nil)
	end)
	if not ok or #session.ucis == before then
		pcall(function()
			App.playMove(uci)
		end)
	end
	return true, uci
end

local function humanDelay()
	local lo = math.min(RUNTIME.DELAY_MIN, RUNTIME.DELAY_MAX)
	local hi = math.max(RUNTIME.DELAY_MIN, RUNTIME.DELAY_MAX)
	if hi - lo < 0.2 then
		return lo
	end
	return lo + math.random() * (hi - lo)
end

local function autopilotTick(session, ply)
	if not RUNTIME.AUTO then
		return
	end
	if session.over or not session:isMyTurn() then
		return
	end
	if session.viewPly ~= ply or S.busy or not S.best then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now < S.thinkAt then
		return
	end
	local uci = pickMove(session)
	if type(uci) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		if not alive() then
			return
		end
		if App.session == session and not session.over and session:isMyTurn() then
			playUci(uci)
		end
	end)
end

-- gui -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local gui = nil
local panel = nil
local rows = {}
local btns = {}
local dot = nil
local dragged = false
local lastEval = nil

-- forward declarations: the buttons are wired before these are defined
local toggleAuto, playNow, copyPosition, refreshButtons, syncDelay, applyPreset, startBotGame

local C_BG = Color3.fromRGB(17, 18, 22)
local C_IDLE = Color3.fromRGB(36, 39, 46)

local C_ACC = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0)

local function mkText(parent, y, h, size, color, bold, x)
	local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	t.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CFG.W - 28 - (x or 14), h)
	t.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x or 14, y)
	t.Font = bold and Enum.Font.GothamBold or Enum.Font.Gotham
	t.TextSize = size
	t.TextColor3 = color

	RUNTIME.DELAY_MIN = math.floor(lo / CFG.DELAY_STEP + 0.5) * CFG.DELAY_STEP
	RUNTIME.DELAY_MAX = math.floor(hi / CFG.DELAY_STEP + 0.5) * CFG.DELAY_STEP
	if RUNTIME.DELAY_MAX - RUNTIME.DELAY_MIN < CFG.DELAY_STEP then

-- the game already ships a chess-style eval bar next to the board, it is just never
-- switched on during a normal game. Feeding it our score wakes it up.
local GAME_KINDS = {
	bot = true,
	online = true,
	puzzle = true,
	rush = true,
}

local function pushEval()
	local session = App.session
	local kind = session and session.kind
	if not session or not kind or not GAME_KINDS[kind] then
		lastEval = nil
		return
	end
	if S.busy or not S.best then
		return
	end
	local score = S.score
	if lastEval == score then
		return
	end
	lastEval = score
	local mate = nil
	if math.abs(score) >= 29900 then
		mate = math.max(1, math.floor((30000 - math.abs(score)) / 100 + 0.5))
	end
	pcall(function()
		App.setEval(score, mate)
	end)
end

local function formatClock(ms)
	if type(ms) ~= "number" then
		return "-"
	end
	ms = math.max(0, ms)
	local total = math.floor(ms / 1000)
	return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(total / 60), total % 60)
end

local function evalText(score)
	local abs = math.abs(score)
	if abs >= 29900 then
		local moves = math.max(1, math.floor((30000 - abs) / 100 + 0.5))
		return string.format("M%d %s", moves, score > 0 and "white" or "black")
	end
	local pawns = score / 100
	return string.format("%s%.2f", pawns >= 0 and "+" or "", pawns)
end

local function refreshPanel(session, ply)
	if not panel or not panel.Parent then
		return
	end

	rows.title.Text = "ROCHESS ENGINE"
	rows.status.Text = S.status
	rows.eval.Text = session
		and (S.busy and "EVAL ...      DEPTH ..." or string.format("EVAL %s      DEPTH %d", evalText(S.score), S.depth))
		or "EVAL -      DEPTH 0"
	if S.busy then
		rows.best.Text = "1 thinking..."
		rows.rest.Text = ""
	else
		rows.best.Text = S.best and string.format("1  %s   (%s)", S.san or "?", S.best) or "1  -"
		local parts = {}
		if S.second then
			table.insert(parts, string.format("2  %s", S.secondSan or S.second))
		end
		if S.third then
			table.insert(parts, string.format("3  %s", S.thirdSan or S.third))
		end
		rows.rest.Text = table.concat(parts, "     ")
	end
	local myClock, oppClock = "-", "-"
	if session and session.clocks and session.myColor then
		myClock = formatClock(session.clocks[session.myColor])
		oppClock = formatClock(session.clocks[-session.myColor])
	end
	rows.game.Text = session
		and string.format("%s | ply %d | clock %s/%s",
			session.myColor == 1 and (session.white and session.white.display or "white")
				or (session.black and session.black.display or "black"),
			ply,
			myClock,
			oppClock)
		or "no game"

	if session and session.kind == "idle" then
		rows.status.Text = "no game running - press BOT GAME or Play in the game"
	end

	if dot then
		if S.busy then
			dot.BackgroundColor3 = C_ACC
		elseif S.best then
			dot.BackgroundColor3 = CFG.ARROW_1
		else
			dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 80, 70)
		end
	end

	pushEval()
end

task.spawn(function()
	while alive() do
		local session = App.session
		local ply = session and #session.ucis or -1
		local sid = session and session.id or nil

		if session and sid ~= S.sessionId then
			S.sessionId = sid
			lastEval = nil
			pcall(function()
				Bot.clearTT()
			end)
		end

		if session and ply ~= S.ply then
			S.ply = ply
			-- a new position means a fresh think time, exactly like a human
			S.thinkAt = os.clock() + humanDelay()
			S.best = nil
			S.san = nil
			S.second = nil
			S.third = nil
			S.secondSan = nil
			S.thirdSan = nil
			clearArrows()
			if not S.busy then
				S.busy = true
				local startFen = session.startFen
				local moves = table.clone(session.ucis)
				local wantPly = ply

				task.spawn(function()
					-- main search: the best move and the eval
					local res = analyseBest(startFen, moves)
					if not alive() then
						return
					end
					S.busy = false
					local live = App.session
					if not live or #live.ucis ~= wantPly then
						S.ply = -1
						return
					end
					if type(res) ~= "table" then
						S.status = "engine failed"
						return
					end
					S.best = res.best
					S.score = tonumber(res.score) or 0
					S.depth = tonumber(res.depth) or 0
					S.status = "engine ready"
